title: Juniper and the Hollow
premise: When the border wards collapse and the stars vanish in a single night, Ivo Thackeray discovers both catastrophes were caused by the Hollow Court beneath Mount Serle, which has begun consuming souls to fuel a stolen crown of night. Among the souls taken is her former master Juniper's — sold years ago by Ivo's own betrayal, the secret she has run from for twelve years. To reclaim it, Ivo must pose as a charm-seller in the Court's twilight market, ally with a ward-keeper's disgraced son and a starless ghost who remembers her name, and confront the corrupt magistrate who taught her that power is simply taken. In the end Ivo shatters the crown by giving back the piece of Juniper's soul she unknowingly kept in her own charms, restoring the stars at the cost of her magic — and chooses, at last, to stay.
about_author: Bram Fairweather is the pen name of a former archivist who claims to have catalogued a collection of unlabeled grimoires and never quite recovered. Juniper and the Hollow is their second novel, following the quietly acclaimed The Saltwright's Daughter.

chapters.title: Charms for a Lawless City
chapters.summary: Ivo sells a luck-knot to a dockworker in Greyharrow, hiding her craft from the wardens who hang hedge-witches. A child pays with a coin that hums wrong. POV: Ivo. Beat: wary competence masking twelve years of guilt.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: The border wards shatter and the sky goes black; panic floods the city. Ivo's charms all die at once — except one, which begins to glow and pull her north. POV: Ivo. Beat: dread and reluctant recognition that her past has found her.

chapters.title: What Juniper Left in the Walls
chapters.summary: Following the charm, Ivo returns to her abandoned apprenticeship cottage and finds Juniper's journal, half-burned, naming a debt sold to the Hollow Court. POV: Ivo, with journal excerpts. Beat: grief curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: The Ward-Keeper's Son
chapters.summary: On the mountain road Ivo is caught by Tam Vey, son of the ward-keeper who built the failed wards — and who vanished the same night. Tam needs a witch; Ivo needs a guide. POV: Ivo. Beat: distrust becoming uneasy alliance.

chapters.title: The Ghost Who Knew Her Name
chapters.summary: A starless ghost called Wren attaches to Ivo, speaking in Juniper's cadence, though she denies being Juniper. She knows things no stranger should. POV: Ivo. Beat: uncanny fear; the first hint Ivo's betrayal is the story's hinge.

chapters.title: Serle's Twilight Market
chapters.summary: The trio enters the Court's surface market, where souls are traded as currency and Ivo poses as a charm-seller again — this time as bait. POV: Ivo. Beat: seduction of power; she is tempted to simply buy her way in.

chapters.title: The Magistrate's Lesson
chapters.summary: Ivo encounters Corvane Ash, the magistrate who once taught her that magic is taken, not given — now the Court's broker of souls. He offers her Juniper's soul in exchange for her service. POV: Ivo. Beat: the past offering a comfortable cage.

chapters.title: Tam's Inheritance
chapters.summary: Tam discovers his father's ward-ledgers: the wards weren't broken, they were sold — by his father, to protect Tam. POV: Tam. Beat: inheritance as wound; loyalty shaken.

chapters.title: Bargaining with the Hollow
chapters.summary: Ivo descends toward the Court proper through the Underway, guided by Wren, who grows more solid with every mile — as if fed by proximity to the crown. POV: Ivo. Beat: claustrophobic dread, deepening mystery.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Ivo witnesses the Hollow Court: a glittering, starving court of the soul-drained, crowned by the Crown of Night that ate the stars. POV: Ivo. Beat: awe and horror; power's corruption made visible.

chapters.title: A Soul on the Shelf
chapters.summary: Ivo finds Juniper's soul in Ash's vault, dim but intact — and learns Juniper sold it willingly, to buy Ivo's escape twelve years ago. POV: Ivo. Beat: guilt inverted; the betrayal was Juniper's sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Price of a Name
chapters.summary: Wren finally admits she is the fragment of Juniper that stayed with Ivo, given flesh by the crown's hunger. To restore Juniper whole, Wren must be given back. POV: Wren. Beat: heartbreak; identity as the theme's sharp edge.

chapters.title: Ash's Offer, Again
chapters.summary: Ash reveals the crown chose Ivo long ago; her runaway was permitted so she could be ripe. He offers her a place beside it — power without limits. POV: Ivo. Beat: the corruption theme at full strength; temptation nearly wins.

chapters.title: Tam Breaks the Ledger
chapters.summary: Tam, inside the Court under his father's old credentials, sabotages the soul-ledgers, buying Ivo a window — and is captured. POV: Tam. Beat: sacrifice and consequence; the alliance's first real cost.

chapters.title: The Theft
chapters.summary: Ivo steals Juniper's soul from the vault in a sequence of small charms, the humble craft she despised proving mightier than Court grandeur. POV: Ivo. Beat: triumph shadowed by pursuit; alarms rise through the mountain.

chapters.title: Flight Through the Underway
chapters.summary: Hunted through the dark, Ivo and Wren carry the soul toward the surface while the Court's hunger wakes behind them. POV: Ivo. Beat: desperate momentum; Wren begins to fade as the crown reaches for her.

chapters.title: What the Crown Wants
chapters.summary: Cornered, Ivo learns the crown cannot be destroyed — only unmade by returning what it took, piece by piece, including Wren. POV: Ivo and Wren, alternating. Beat: the choice crystallizes; no clean way out.

chapters.title: The Summit of Serle
chapters.summary: At the broken ward-stone on the peak, Ivo begins the unmaking under a starless sky, the Court rising from the mountain to stop her. POV: Ivo. Beat: climax begins; every debt comes due at once.

chapters.title: Juniper and the Hollow
chapters.summary: Ash and Ivo duel with charms against crown-magic; Ivo refuses to take his power and instead gives hers away, starving the crown. Wren steps into the returning soul. POV: Ivo. Beat: renunciation as victory; the title's meaning fulfilled.

chapters.title: The Stars Return
chapters.summary: The crown shatters; the stars reignite; Juniper wakes whole in Ivo's arms, remembering everything — including the twelve lost years and Wren's sacrifice. POV: Ivo. Beat: catharsis and grief braided together.

chapters.title: Ash's Reckoning
chapters.summary: Powerless without the crown, Ash is claimed by the souls he brokered; Tam rebuilds the wards with his father's ledger as a warning, not a blueprint. POV: Tam. Beat: justice without triumph; corruption answered.

chapters.title: The Hedge-Witch Who Stayed
chapters.summary: Ivo, her magic spent, opens a small shop in Greyharrow with Juniper — selling honest charms that are only knots and patience, and finding that is enough. POV: Ivo. Beat: quiet resolution; identity chosen, not inherited.
